tooManyBlocks: Block {{block}}: At most 5000 subtitle blocks are supported.
numberRequired: Block {{block}}: Expected a nonnegative integer on its own line. Unrecognized content cannot be skipped.
invalidInterval: Block {{block}}: Start must not exceed end; boundaries must be within 0–35999990ms. Times are never clamped.
missingSeparator: Block {{block}}: Separate blocks with an empty line. Standalone timing lines cannot appear in text.
unrepresentableText: Block {{block}}: Literal braces or backslashes cannot be represented losslessly in the current ASS subset. Keep the original.
controlCharacter: Block {{block}}: Text contains a control character or line break unsupported by the document model.
unbalancedTag: Block {{block}}: Basic formatting tags must be properly paired and nested.
unsupportedTag: Block {{block}}: Only attribute-free b/i/u/s tags are supported. Unknown or broken tags are never silently removed.
invalidEntity: Block {{block}}: Entities must represent valid Unicode; named entities must be supported and end with a semicolon.
textTooLong: Block {{block}}: Converted text must not exceed 16384 characters.
blankTextLine: Block {{block}}: Leading, trailing or consecutive line breaks cannot be represented unambiguously in SRT. Export ASS instead.
timingInText: Block {{block}}: A standalone timing-like text line cannot be represented unambiguously in SRT. Export ASS instead.
encoding: Only UTF-8 SRT (with or without BOM) is supported. Keep the original and save a copy with UTF-8 encoding before retrying.
importNotice: SRT was converted to the shared subtitle document with new-document default styles. Times round to the nearest 10ms (ties upward, at most 5ms per boundary). Very short cues may become zero duration.
exportLimitations: SRT preserves event order and basic b/i/u/s formatting. ASS fonts, colors, transparency, positioning, layers, comments and script metadata are omitted. Soft breaks become line breaks; nonbreaking spaces are preserved. Only applied in-memory subtitles are exported; the project is not saved. Transparent text becomes visible.
